pages.title: Compact Floppy Bay
pages.text: The Compact Floppy Bay holds four 3½-inch floppies. It needs a floppy era processor on the network, such as the Floppy Disk Processor or Floppy Disk Workstation.$(br2)Sneak-right-click a bay with a disk to put it in, or with an empty hand to take it out. Right-click elsewhere to open its slots.
